guide.office: Office of the Building Official / City Engineering Office
guide.location: Tagaytay City Hall, Akle St., Kaybagal South
guide.hours: Confirm current receiving hours with the office.

checklist: Download and review the complete official building checklist
Prepare the required title, tax, lease, and authority documents
Arrange signed and sealed plans/forms with the responsible professionals
Follow the checklist’s copy count and project-specific clearances
